This market will resolve to "Up" if the Pyth BTC/USD price at December 07, 2025 at 00:00:00 +00:00 is lower than at December 07, 2025 at 23:59:59 +00:00.

This market will resolve to "Down" if the Pyth BTC/USD price at December 07, 2025 at 00:00:00 +00:00 is higher than at December 07, 2025 at 23:59:59 +00:00.

If the two prices for these timestamps are exactly equal, this market will resolve 50-50.

The resolution source for this market is the Pyth Network BTC/USD price feed (0xe62df6c8b4a85fe1a67db44dc12de5db330f7ac66b72dc658afedf0f4a415b43). If Pyth data is unavailable, admin may use Binance, Coinbase or any other exchange as fallback.
